summary: Osisko Development Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing results from a 13,000-meter infill drilling program at its Cariboo Gold Project in British Columbia, Canada. The release details drill intercepts, including grades up to 133.62 g/t gold over 0.5 meters. No transaction, tender offer, or special situation is reported; the filing is a routine operational update by the issuer.
